channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Foreign investors urge Vietnam to accelerate reforms to further boost investment appeal
item.description: Several foreign investors say they remain confident in Vietnam's investment environment but hope the government will press ahead with reforms in areas such as labor policy flexibility, institutional development, and long-term regulatory stability to make the country even more attractive to foreign capital.

item.title: Passenger boat carrying 23 sinks after evening collision in northern Vietnam
item.description: A passenger boat carrying 23 people sank after colliding with a stone-laden ferry on Thac Ba Lake in northern Vietnam on Saturday evening, leaving six people missing, authorities said.

item.title: Norwegian tourist hands over lost wallet to police in south-central Vietnam
item.description: A Norwegian visitor came to a police station in Bac Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa Province, south-central Vietnam to hand over a wallet picked up along Luong Son Pass on Friday, an officer said on Saturday.

item.title: Traffic police plan outbound lane closures as flows of vehicles head back to Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City
item.description: The Traffic Police Department on Saturday night announced a plan to temporarily close outbound expressway lanes from Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City on Sunday in order to prioritize the surging flow of vehicles returning to the two major cities as the Lunar New Year holiday ends.

item.title: Man City crank up pressure on Arsenal, Villa and Chelsea drop points
item.description: Manchester City are now breathing down the necks of Premier League leaders Arsenal after a hard-fought 2-1 home win over Newcastle United reduced the gap to two points on Saturday.

item.title: Dragon Capital chair urges Vietnam to shift from gold hoarding to long-term investing
item.description: Dominic Scriven, chairman at Dragon Capital, a leading Vietnam-focused asset manager, has called on Vietnam to strengthen its capital markets and move away from the traditional mindset of hoarding gold, as the country faces record foreign sell-offs and mounting pressure to finance mega infrastructure projects.

item.title: AI revolution looms over Berlin film fest
item.description: The artificial intelligence revolution sweeping through the entertainment sector was at first glance not evident at this year's Berlin Film Festival, but the potential for widespread changes was still on people's minds.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City welcomes international visitors with lucky money, calligraphy for Tet
item.description: Fifty international tourists staying at properties operated by Saigontourist Group joined a special Lunar New Year (Tet) celebration hosted by the group in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam’s southern hub, on Saturday, the fifth day of the first lunar month and the eighth day of the nine-day Tet holiday.

item.title: Vietnamese UAV ingenuity lights up the skies
item.description: When historic floods swept through several northern provinces such as Thai Nguyen in early October 2025, cutting off many communes and bringing rescue vehicles to a halt, made-in-Vietnam unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) played a vital role in supporting flood-hit residents.
